```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

##Import NSDUH

```{r }
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html = 
  read_html(url)
```

Pull the tables out

```{r}
maj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)

maj_df
```
table pulls out each object that looks like a table [[n]] = number of table pulled out.
slice() - if you want to specifically eliminate a 
filter() - usually you want filter bu


##Import of SW data

pull in the html

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```
read html - pulls html
read_html_live - built on r package that uses chrome in the background. Might or might not work

selector gadget

```{r}
swml_title_vec =
  swm_html |>  
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |> 
  html_text()

swm_metascore_vec =
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |>
  html_text()

runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".base .ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |>
  html_text()


swm_df =
  tibble(
    title = swm_title_vec,
    score = swm_metascore_vec,
    runtime = swm_runtime_vec
  )
  
```

## Use APIs

getting a csv

```{r}
nyc_water_df =
  GET(https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv) |> 
    content("parsed") |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per)
```
api endpoint - when ask data from this thing gets to the write server
Try to minimize the times you scrape data


Getting a json file instead
```{r}
nyc_water_json =
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json")

nyc_water_json |> 
  content("text") |> 
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons)

head(nyc_water_json)
```

Look at some pokemon!
```{r}
pokemon =
  GET("https://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1")

pokemon_data =
  pokemon_json |> 
  content()

pokemon_data[["name"]]
pokemon_data[["height"]]
pokemon_data[["abilities"]]
```
pulling in all of that information and makes it somewhat trickier. If you want to use API to get more complicated, it will in fact be more complicated
